;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**The death toll from yesterday's suicide attack on protesters in eastern [[Afghanistan]] rises to 68. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/09/afghanistan-suicide-bomber-kills-32-attack-protesters-180911132240204.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Business and economy
*The [[France|French]] railway company [[SNCF]] announces prototypes for [[Automatic train operation|driverless passenger and freight trains]] by 2023. [https://phys.org/news/2018-09-france-driverless-mainline-years.html (Phys.org)]

;Disasters and accidents
*14 people died and 24 others were injured when the brakes of an overloaded passenger van failed while the van was traveling on a winding road in northern [[Philippines]]. [https://www.bostonglobe.com/news/world/2018/09/12/dead-philippine-passenger-van-falls-off-cliff/Dxlv54tWqovPsRfa13VrCK/story.html (''The Boston Globe'')]
*At least 20 people are killed in central [[Mali]] when a truck plunges into a river after a suspected brake failure. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mali-accident/at-least-20-killed-in-mali-after-truck-falls-into-river-idUSKCN1LS31I (Reuters)]
*[[2018 Atlantic hurricane season]], [[Hurricane Florence]]
**[[Amtrak]] modifies services and cancels train services south of [[Washington, D.C.]] ahead of [[Hurricane Florence]]. [[FlightAware]] reported that 180 flights have been cancelled. [[Charleston International Airport]] in [[South Carolina]] is expected to close by midnight. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/transportation/2018/09/10/trains-canceled-airlines-waiving-fees-east-coast-braces-hurricane-florence/ (''The Washington Post'')]

;Law and crime
*A man plows his car into a crowd of people at a busy square in [[Hengyang]], [[Hunan]], [[China]], before exiting his vehicle and stabbing bystanders. Eleven people are killed and 44 others are injured. The attacker was detained and identified by police as a convicted drug dealer and thief, who said that "he wanted to take revenge on society". [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/society/article/2163963/3-killed-after-driver-ploughs-through-busy-town-square-central (''South China Morning Post'')]
*Five people are killed in a string of shootings in [[Bakersfield, California|Bakersfield]], [[California]], before the gunman fatally shoots himself. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-california-shooting/gunman-kills-five-people-in-a-series-of-shootings-in-california-police-idUSKCN1LT0EQ (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Treaty on European Union]]
**The [[European Parliament]] votes 448–197 to trigger [[Article 7 of the Treaty on European Union|article 7]] against [[Hungary]] for flouting the rule of law in the country. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/09/eu-lawmakers-disciplinary-action-hungary-180912112849564.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2017–18 Iranian protests]]
**Iranian Kurdish shopkeepers begin a [[Iranian Kurdistan|region-wide]] strike against the executions of Kurdish activists and the [[Western Iran clashes (2016–present)|bombing]] of opposition parties in [[Koy Sanjaq|Koya]] in the neighboring [[Iraqi Kurdistan Region]]. [http://www.kurdistan24.net/en/news/423a2c65-03ff-410c-abdf-ef8793720642 (Kurdistan24)]
*[[2018 G20 Buenos Aires summit]]
**[[Office of the United States Trade Representative|Deputy US Trade Representative]] [[Dennis Shea (lawyer)|Dennis Shea]] will represent the [[United States]] at the [[G20|Group of 20]] trade ministerial meeting in [[Argentina]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-g20-argentina-trade/deputy-ustr-shea-to-represent-u-s-at-g20-trade-ministers-meeting-idUSKCN1LS2GC (Reuters)]

;Sports
*[[2018 WNBA season]]
**In the [[2018 WNBA Finals|WNBA Finals]], the [[Seattle Storm]] win the [[List of WNBA champions|WNBA championship]] with a 98-92 win over the [[Washington Mystics]]. [https://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/seattle-storm-wins-wnba-championship_us_5b9a58b7e4b041978dc06f16 (''Huffington Post'')]
